text: Day one. Five A M. It's dark. In Delhi this winter, the sun won't rise for almost two hours. The house is silent. No messages. Nobody needs you. {playful} You feel like a CEO. You make your bed. You post a photo of the sky. (beat) {neutral} If you used to wake at seven, you just found two extra hours a day. Over a month, that's sixty hours. Free.
